briefdescription.para: Constructs a pane with the given UUID identity.

parameterdescription.para: Unique identifier — stored as componentID and ID::id VT property.

briefdescription.para: Sets focus=1 on this pane's state node when keyboard focus is gained.
Sets focus=0 on this pane's state node when keyboard focus is lost.
Stub pane component with ValueTree node identity.

detaileddescription.para: Each PaneView owns a PANE node (via jam::Model::Component) identified by a UUID. Seeds focus=0 and stores the UUID as both componentID (for PaneManager matching) and as an ID::id VT property (for model tree inspection). Empty in Phase 3 — terminal::View subclasses this in Phase 4.
